name: SARTech
tagline: Predicts where a lost person will move, using terrain and behaviour models, to guide search-and-rescue drones.
problem: Drone searches usually follow a lawnmower pattern that assumes the missing person stays still.
solution: A Monte Carlo model that incorporates how lost people behave (for example, following a river) over real geographic data to produce a probability map that steers the drone.
demo_moment: Team-described: run the simulation over a map and see the drone's search area shift.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Most Technically Complex Hack” among 85 submissions.
Models human psychology instead of assuming a stationary target.
Drone hobbyists applied their own hardware experience.

lessons: Challenge the default assumption of the existing method and show the difference.
